title: Chip Hungerbar
description: Turn your Hungerbar into crispy RAM!
body:
## CHIPS
Either you are a protogen, an AI, or a computer wizard, this Resource Pack is for you!

Why have a boring Hungerbar when you could be eating RAM!

Replace the Vanilla Hungerbar with some crunchy RAM!

![Chip Hungerbar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2adf98e3e91fab8e3bdfc4fb7ff43549f9fb841e_0.webp)

What are you waiting for? Turn your Hungerbar into Microchips now!
